description.en: Install a writing workflow, import a draft, and write your first chapter.
description.zh: 安装写作工具，导入已有书稿，写出第一章。

description.en: Plan openings, chapters, suspense, pacing, and endings.
description.zh: 从开篇、大纲到伏笔、节奏和结尾，把故事写完整。

description.en: Build believable motives, distinct voices, and relationships.
description.zh: 写清人物动机，区分对白，让感情与人物成长落在行动上。

description.en: Choose a genre and learn the story patterns it needs.
description.zh: 选择适合自己的题材，掌握言情、悬疑、玄幻等类型的写法。

description.en: Fix weak prose, continuity mistakes, and chapters that stall.
description.zh: 去AI味、查前后矛盾，解决卡文、注水和追读下降。
设计封面构图与书名字体，检查上传裁剪和缩略图辨识。
description.en: Plan cover art and lettering, then check upload crops and thumbnail readability.
Adapt a story into episodes, scenes, and shootable dialogue.
description.zh: 把小说和点子改成分集大纲、可表演的剧本与台词。

description.en: Plan shots, keep characters consistent, and improve generated footage.
description.zh: 写分镜、参考图与视频提示词，修复角色和镜头不连贯。

description.en: Turn a novel into player actions, branching stories, and a playable game.
description.zh: 把小说改成可玩的游戏，设计分支、任务、对白和结局。

description.en: Write narration from footage, edit a story, and finish audio and subtitles.
description.zh: 从现有视频写解说、剪故事，处理配音、原声与字幕。
